	<ResortReportHeadline>Super Saturday and Gotcha Chair set to spin!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>There are stars overhead, an almost full moon setting in the west and a bright glow rising in the east. The snowguns are blazing and it looks like it'll be a Super Saturday.&nbsp; The current temp is minus 2.3, heading for a top of 4 degrees and the wind is a moderate northerly, which is predicted to increase after the close of play.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>The snow should be in really good shape for carving turns on the groomers from the get-go, and there'll be plenty of fun off piste options too.&nbsp; Many south facing slopes will still have some dry packed snow on them, while the more north facing aspects may be firm to start but soften as the day warms.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Road Runner is scheduled for 7:30am WRX First Tracks this morning, and Gotcha will open once the final slope preparations have been completed. There should be good turns on Initiation, Greenline and Skating Rink but The Extreme Area will remain closed.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Slap on the screen and have a beaut day out there!</p><p>Cheers Bill</p></ResortReport>

	<Backcountry>1 August 2026
The conditions in the backcountry are variable, but you may find some good turns out there.  Some aspects are still holding dry snow, while others have moved into a melt freeze cycle and will be slick to start the day.  The cover is good up high but becomes much more marginal at lower elevations.  Beware of a sliding hazard.  Take Care.  </Backcountry>
